shape: someone does a small thing for you and never mentions it; name that as love

slides.text: you scraped the ice off my windscreen before my alarm went off, and [[left the keys by my shoes]] without a word.

caption:
he never talked about the cold mornings.
he always left the car ready before you stepped out.
send this to the dad who always clears the ice before you leave.

#dad #dadquotes #fatherson #father
alt: a small green donkey standing serenely next to text about a dad quietly scraping ice off a car windscreen.
hook_options: you scraped the ice off my windscreen before my alarm went off, and left the keys by my shoes without a word.
you checked the air in my tyres every sunday evening, and never once asked where i was planning to go.
you started my car ten minutes early on winter mornings, so the seats were warm before i walked outside.
